name: Soul Labyrinth
source: Soul Labyrinth takes place in a world of humans, elves and beastkin. Choose to follow either beastkin, Jou or Katnir as they learn the art of 'soul weaving' from the elven masters. Partner with either the noble elf Reith or the cunning human Seladre. Navigate their relationship dynamics both inside and outside of the dream world.
